Name: Opal Paths
Author: strangelyliteral
Description:
[b]UPDATE:[/b] I fixed the error in the manifest. Should be all good now.


"Make crystal paths out of the opals," my brain said. "It will be fun," it said.

This mod takes opal assets for the museum and turns them into crystal paths for your farm. I've even updated the inventory icon to match. Available in original and fire varieties.


[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download the paths you want.
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley > Mods folder and unzip the file.
[/list]
To remove, either delete the folder or change the "Enabled" flags to false in the content.json file. (You can also edit the flags to swap between regular opal and fire opal paths!)


[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
These will override the Flooring.xnb, but since they're a content patcher pack (CPP), no game files will be changed. They will conflict with CPPs  that alter the same assets. They're also not compatible with Seasonal Immersion mods that edit the Flooring.xnb file. If you wish to use these mods and SI floors together, you'll have to edit the SI pngs to include my paths (check the assets folder for PNGs of the textures).
